name: Kharad Compact
summary: A league of mercantile city-states, banks, merchant houses and treaty networks whose civilization prizes agreement, reputation, patient negotiation and honest measure.
government: League of city-states, banks, merchant houses and treaty networks
gateAttitude: Kharad sees the Gate era as a new world of value, risk, credit and exchange.
beliefs: The dominant religion is the **Covenant of the One**, a monotheistic revelation tradition built around the One, Measure, moral accountability, Messengers, scripture, law and the Final Account. It is not a First Light denomination, but it recognizes Qorvan (Corven) as a mortal Messenger, which gives it both common ground and disagreements with the First Light traditions.
visualSummary: Cities of pale stone, turquoise, copper, patterned textiles, formal masks and dense commercial architecture.

relations.text: Deeply interdependent: finance and insurance for imperial markets and naval protection.
Warm, practical trade; Kharadis find the Vardic distrust of debt sensible, if unsophisticated.
An important customer and a loud critic.
One of the oldest great trade relationships: patient negotiation on both sides.
Distant, complicated and functional, for reasons that go back to the Silencing of the Schools.

extraRule: An extra Mild Consequence slot, **Minor Obligation**: instead of paying up to 2 Coins, someone covers the cost and you record the debt. You clear it by completing a Project and offering its result to the Kharad Compact.
